frontmatter.p: AN ACT TO EXTEND THE LIMIT OF TIME IMPOSED BY THE TRADE LOANS (GUARANTEE) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1925, ON THE GIVING OF GUARANTEES AND THE MAKING OF LOANS UNDER THE TRADE LOANS (GUARANTEE) ACT, 1924, AND TO MODIFY THE AGGREGATE CAPITAL AMOUNTS IN RESPECT OF WHICH GUARANTEES MAY BE GIVEN AND OF THE LOANS WHICH MAY BE MADE UNDER THE LAST-MENTIONED ACT. [17th July, 1926.]

sect.p: 1.In this Act the expression the Principal Act means the Trade Loans (Guarantee) Act, 1924 (No. 41 of 1924).
